remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive. Abiquiú Notebooks indicates, "Note: dated by O'Keeffe. Note: Given to Mrs. Young's daughter, Eleanor by O'K." Stretcher inscription 1 dates 1922 and indicates no. 101 in 1923 New York (Anderson). Dated 1920 on basis of similarities of vase or floral forms to cat. nos. 320–22. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 14. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A bouquet of flowers sits in a dark, opalescent vase. The flowers include a white daisy, a purple thistle, and clusters of pink spirea. Dark green leaves flank the blooms. The arrangement sits against a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of the RISD Museum, Providence, RI.
title: Pink Spirea
